messages:
olga - sales: Heads up — RetailBank wants a short POC for on-prem private deployment. They're asking for a minimal preflight checklist and the access flow for granting us temporary validation access. Also pricing for a 2-node trial.

diego - infra: Minimal preflight: GPU drivers (NVIDIA >=470), cuda: 11.6+, nvidia-container-toolkit present, k8s 1.23-1.25, kernel >=5.11. We prefer Ubuntu 22.04 or RHEL8.6. Need the node role to allow privileged pods for device-plugin.

olga - sales: They asked about air-gapped install — can we do a fully offline install?

diego - infra: Yes. We have an offline bundle tar.gz containing images and the installer binary plus checksums. We'll provide a signed manifest. For the control plane handshake we either run a private control plane in their VPC or for fully air-gapped they'll use our on-prem package and we provide periodic offline telemetry manifests.

sam - security: For the questionnaire: require KMS integration options (customer-managed), FIPS mode note, and ability to export audit logs via syslog/S3 gateway. We'll need the contact for their security ops to exchange cert fingerprints.

tess - solutions: For the access flow: request temporary SSH to one node (jump host) limited to specific IP and time window. We'll also ask for a kubeconfig with a read-only service account for prometheus/runtime checks. We'll provide a signed NDA for any sensitive logs.

deploy-bot: preflight-scan: nodes found: 2 GPU nodes (T4), driver: 470.129, cuda: 11.4 (outdated), nvidia-toolkit: missing, kernel: 5.4. Recommendation: upgrade CUDA to 11.6+, install nvidia-container-toolkit.

diego - infra: Good catch from bot — T4 works but need cuda upgrade. For T4 prefer driver 470+ and toolkit. I'll draft the exact install commands.

olga - sales: Pricing request — can we do a trial rate for 2 nodes for 30 days? Include a note about potential upgrade to Dedicated pool if performance looks good.

tess - solutions: Yes we can offer a POC credit pricing — I'll draft a 30-day trial quote and include estimated token throughput.

sam - security: Also note that for PCI-regulated workloads, we recommend private KMS + HSM and no external outbound during inference. We'll document required attestations.

olga - sales: Next steps: @tess send trial quote; @diego share offline bundle link + install command; @sam get contact for cert exchange. I'll coordinate SSH window with the customer.

diego - infra: Quick install snippet for toolkit and runtime (Ubuntu):
```
# update
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get upgrade -y
# install driver (example)
sudo apt install -y linux-headers-$(uname -r) build-essential
sudo bash NVIDIA-Linux-x86_64-515.run --silent
# docker runtime
distribution=$(. /etc/os-release;echo $ID$VERSION_ID)
curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/nvidia-docker/gpgkey | sudo apt-key add -
curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/nvidia-docker/$distribution/nvidia-docker.list | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvidia-docker.list
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit
sudo systemctl restart docker
```

olga - sales: Great. I'll follow up with RetailBank for the SSH window and security contact. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
